name: precipitation
normalizations: Compare cauldrons after rain at random_tick_speed 4096, when every one has caught rain to the brim (about 40 fills expected each, so a slow runner still fills them); the loaded area's grass is replaced with stone so only precipitation ticks.
Use matching flat terrain and ignore clocks, sound seeds and generated IDs.
Covers ServerLevel.tickPrecipitation's column picks and CauldronBlock/LayeredCauldronBlock filling with rain; freezing and snow need a cold biome and are not compared.
